5paisa Review (2026): Brokerage, Platforms, API & Execution - The Published Facts

5paisa, part of the IIFL group and listed on Indian exchanges, was one of the earliest flat-fee discount brokers in India. It charges a uniform ₹20 per order across segments and layers optional subscription packs for research and higher-touch features. Its execution-speed figure here (median ≈ 85 ms) is taken from the independent AlgoTest Broker Speedtest, where its place-order latency is measured live during market hours.

By the Indian Broker Test editorial desk · Published 9 July 2026 · Data last reviewed 10 July 2026 · Independent

Frequently asked questions

What brokerage does 5paisa charge?

Per its official pricing at our last review: delivery ₹20 per order (flat); intraday ₹20 per order (flat); F&O ₹20 per order (flat). Statutory charges apply on top. Verify the current schedule on the official pricing page, as rates change without notice.

Does 5paisa offer a trading API?

Yes - 5paisa Xtream API. Published pricing: See official developer page. See the official documentation for rate limits and terms.

How fast is 5paisa's order execution?

The published figure is ≈ 85 ms (median), from a published third-party comparison. It is approximate, not independently audited, and varies with device, network and market conditions.

Who is 5paisa best suited for?

Cost-conscious traders comfortable with a subscription add-on model.
